bio:
RAND w/ ROBOTICALEE

*Monthly*

ROBOTICALEE is a North Carolina-based DJ circulating the Black electronic tradition throughout the region and beyond. With this emphasis on Black music, he blends with a vast array of electronic genres, focusing on footwork, jungle, ghettotech, NOLA bounce, jersey club, and more. His love for electronic music has no bounds, and he can be found spinning at any event where he can express this love. Currently, he is learning music production to further his expression.
He also creates and uplifts focused spaces for electronic music to thrive — culminating in his collaboration with local NC creatives to build them. Among them are Future Footwerk, a Chicago footwork tribute party series and 2x Resident Advisor pick, created in collaboration with Durham-based collective Sonic Essence and Aquatic Ambiance, an ambient listening experience organized with his partner, Zeni Pincher.
title: ROBOTICALEE
